name: B10-0061/2024 (S&D) – The devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its opinion and its demands after the September 2024 floods in central and eastern Europe. It asks for faster and simpler emergency money for the affected countries, a bigger EU Solidarity Fund, and a new EU law on adapting to climate change. It also wants stronger flood defences, more tree planting and wetlands, and full use of the nature restoration law.

- The Parliament asks for more money and faster aid; no law changes yet.
- It affects flood-hit countries and regions, farmers, and vulnerable groups.
- Next: the Commission and member states are asked to act on these demands.
